summary: A rock and metal firmware built on SLOOP, for writing riffs and songs on four tracks: drums, bass, rhythm guitar and lead, using sampled guitars and bass through amp models.
features: Sampled guitar and bass presets through five amp models and cabinet IRs
On-screen pedalboard: drives, fuzz, modulation, delay, five reverb types, wah, whammy
Step sequencer with palm mutes, slides, hammer-ons and power chords
LIVE view puts bend, vibrato, palm mute and whammy on the knobs
Editable sampled HEAVY KIT plus synthesised kits; eight synth engines
Sound pack fills all four user sample slots; won't open SLOOP 2.6-2.8 projects
